## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1 (3136): running /dso:brainstorm on an epic that contains UI-copy signals results in the epic carrying the copy-needed tag
- dd-4 (3136): running /dso:brainstorm on an epic with no UI-copy signals leaves the epic without the tag or section

## Description
Add a Phase 1.5 step to plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md that detects UI-copy signals in the in-progress epic description (form fields, error messages, microcopy, plain-language requirements, validation, button labels). When detected, the brainstorm flow surfaces detected items to the user during dialogue for confirmation. On user confirmation, the epic is tagged copy-needed via `.claude/scripts/dso ticket tag <epic-id> copy-needed`.

UI-copy signal heuristics (any-of):
- Description references forms / form fields / form validation
- Description mentions error messages / error states / validation failures
- Description mentions accessibility copy (alt text, ARIA labels)
- Description mentions microcopy / button labels / call-to-action text
- Description references plain-language / reading-level / federal-style guidance
- Acceptance criteria contain user-visible text strings

Idempotency: re-running brainstorm on an epic already tagged copy-needed does not duplicate the tag.

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given a synthetic epic description containing UI-copy signals (e.g., "users see an error message when..."); When the brainstorm Phase 1.5 detector evaluates the description; Then the detector returns positive AND prompts the user to confirm tagging. Given a synthetic epic with no UI-copy signals (e.g., "extend the test gate"); When the detector evaluates; Then it returns negative AND no tag is applied.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] brainstorm SKILL.md has a Phase 1.5 section
  Verify: grep -E '^##.*Phase 1\\.5' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
- [ ] Phase 1.5 documents the UI-copy signal heuristics
  Verify: grep -qE 'copy-needed|UI-copy|form field' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
- [ ] Behavioral test passes (detector positive on UI-copy epic, negative on non-UI epic)
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-brainstorm-phase-1-5-detector.sh
- [ ] Test registered in .test-index
  Verify: grep -q 'test-brainstorm-phase-1-5-detector.sh' plugins/dso/tests/.test-index

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
| plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md | Edit |
| plugins/dso/tests/test-brainstorm-phase-1-5-detector.sh | Create |
| plugins/dso/tests/.test-index | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate to opus then user
